title: The Story Ending Told Wrong
youtube_title: The Story Ending Told Wrong | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Lior is tangled up with a story ending you had changed to sound braver and almost hides it. Lior tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
